description: Clipboard write capability — outbound only (write-text). Chunk #43 snapshot copy-to-clipboard surface. Per security plan §Logging clipboard hygiene the clipboard-write step emits a non-suppressible 'X bytes copied' visible signal via pulse://stream/snapshot-progress event. NEVER add clipboard-manager:allow-read-text or allow-read-image — clipboard read would let the webview exfiltrate user clipboard contents (separate threat surface; would need its own capability with stated rationale). The 'report' window joined the list 2026-08-27: chunk 2026-07-10 moved the Diagnostic Report into its own floating window and this list was never widened, so the report's Copy control was a dead affordance — the writeText IPC was silently ACL-rejected and the bare catch rendered it as 'Copy failed — retry' (measured at HEAD: copy_pressed true, copy_state error). Same outbound write-text permission, one additional window label, no permission added; the read ban above is unchanged.
